name: Hyprland Reference Compositor
summary: Official dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on the looks.
description: Hyprland itself, with its default config. It is an independent Wayland compositor, not based on wlroots, with dwindle, master, scrolling and monocle layouts, window groups, special workspaces, plugins with a built-in plugin manager, and animations driven by bezier and spring curves. The config reloads as soon as you save it. Since Hyprland 0.55 the configuration is written in Lua instead of the older .conf format.

screenshots.alt: Hyprland lock screen and session assets
screenshots.caption: 02_HYPRLAND_ASSET.RAW

steps.title: Install Hyprland and the apps its default config opens
commands: sudo pacman -S --needed hyprland kitty hyprlauncher dolphin

steps.title: Copy the default ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua
commands: # Since Hyprland 0.55 the config is Lua. The default opens kitty (Super+Q), hyprlauncher (Super+R) and dolphin (Super+E); change them at the top of hyprland.lua.
